label: Simple priority is irreflexive, from the priority-requirement bridge (inference)
rule: A self-priority would require both D x x and not D x x
meaning: If whatever is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to x is something on which x depends and which does not depend on x, then nothing is simply prior to itself, whatever D x x is. This holds on both the reflexive and the strict reading of DependsForBeing. A conditional support option for the bare root-route irreflexivity premise; the bridge remains open.
